as_told.title: P3 program: psionic assets carried in the containers

plain: In 2009 a secret US UFO effort is said to have been rounding up people from disaster zones such as Indonesia and testing their psionic ability, meaning powers of the mind. Michels says Michael Herrera, a man who says he saw a huge craft in the Indonesian jungle that year, was later contacted by someone claiming to be from the "Legacy UFO program", who explained it this way. Herrera tells it himself on the show a little differently: he names his source as a man called Jake Barber, says the programme went by "P3", which he says is not its real name, and says the psionic people were carried in shipping containers.
